title: The Authority Resolution Framework: A Five-Domain Ontology for Governing Who and What Decides, at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2608.15832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI systems become increasingly capable of autonomous action, determining whether an agent is technically capable of performing an action is insufficient: the system must also determine whether the action is authorised in its context.   This paper introduces the Authority Resolution Framework (ARF), a five-domain ontology for representing and resolving authority across organisational roles and informal influence, business concepts, codified processes, machine-readable permissions and executable systems, and external real-world context. ARF defines the Authority Relation (AR) as a cross-domain primitive binding an actor, action, object, bounded context, justification chain, and a calibration measure termed the DNA-Coefficient, which captures divergence between documented authority structures and authority as practiced. translated_title: 权威解析框架：一个用于治理谁及什么在规模上做出决定的五域本体论
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15832v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着AI系统在自主行动方面变得越来越强大，确定一个代理在技术上是否有能力执行某项行动已不足够：系统还必须确定该行动在其上下文中是否被授权。本文介绍了权威解析框架（ARF），这是一个五域本体论，用于表示和解析跨组织角色及非正式影响力、商业概念、编码化流程、机器可读权限和可执行系统以及外部现实世界上下文的权威。ARF定义了权威关系（AR）作为一种跨域原语，它绑定了一个行动者、行动、对象、受限上下文、论证链和一种称为DNA系数的校准度量，该系数捕获了文档化权威结构与实际实践中的权威之间的分歧。该框架提供了权威来源和范围的机器可解释表示，采用JSON-LD表示。
tldr: 本文提出了一个五域本体论框架，用于在AI系统中解析权威关系，并通过DNA系数衡量文档权威与实际权威的差异，从而确保行动在上下文中被授权。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a five-domain ontology framework for resolving authority relations in AI systems, using a DNA-Coefficient to capture divergence between documented and practiced authority, ensuring actions are authorized in context.
